default.$description: Body text on the default surface — aliases the brand palette. There's no neutral gray scale yet, so this uses Tinta.

primary.$description: Text in the `primary` role color (Bootstrap `.text-primary`) — aliases `role.primary`.

secondary.$description: Text in the `secondary` role color (Bootstrap `.text-secondary`) — aliases `role.secondary`.

success.$description: Text in the `success` role color (Bootstrap `.text-success`) — aliases `role.success`.

info.$description: Text in the `info` role color (Bootstrap `.text-info`) — aliases `role.info`.

warning.$description: Text in the `warning` role color (Bootstrap `.text-warning`) — aliases `role.warning`.

danger.$description: Text in the `danger` role color (Bootstrap `.text-danger`) — aliases `role.danger`.

light.$description: Text in the `light` role color (Bootstrap `.text-light`) — aliases `role.light`.

dark.$description: Text in the `dark` role color (Bootstrap `.text-dark`) — aliases `role.dark`.

body.$description: Body text (Bootstrap `$body-color`) — aliases `text.default`. Arizona Bootstrap uses gray-900 (`#212529`).

default.$description: Emphasized text with no role (Bootstrap `$emphasis-color`) — aliases `text.default` for now.

primary.$description: Emphasized text in the `primary` role (Bootstrap `$primary-text-emphasis`) — aliases `role.primary` for now.

secondary.$description: Emphasized text in the `secondary` role (Bootstrap `$secondary-text-emphasis`) — aliases `role.secondary` for now.

success.$description: Emphasized text in the `success` role (Bootstrap `$success-text-emphasis`) — aliases `role.success` for now.

info.$description: Emphasized text in the `info` role (Bootstrap `$info-text-emphasis`) — aliases `role.info` for now.

warning.$description: Emphasized text in the `warning` role (Bootstrap `$warning-text-emphasis`) — aliases `role.warning` for now.

danger.$description: Emphasized text in the `danger` role (Bootstrap `$danger-text-emphasis`) — aliases `role.danger` for now.

light.$description: Emphasized text in the `light` role (Bootstrap `$light-text-emphasis`) — aliases `role.light` for now.

dark.$description: Emphasized text in the `dark` role (Bootstrap `$dark-text-emphasis`) — aliases `role.dark` for now.

primary.$description: The `primary` role color (Bootstrap theme color; Arizona Bootstrap `$primary`) — aliases the brand palette.

secondary.$description: The `secondary` role color (Bootstrap theme color; Arizona Bootstrap `$secondary`) — aliases the brand palette.

success.$description: The `success` role color (Bootstrap theme color `success`) — aliases the brand palette. Arizona Bootstrap uses Leaf (`#70b865`); Saguaro is its current-palette name, with a different value.

info.$description: The `info` role color (Bootstrap theme color `info`) — aliases the brand palette. Arizona Bootstrap's Sky, renamed Rain.

warning.$description: The `warning` role color (Bootstrap theme color `warning`) — aliases the brand palette. Arizona Bootstrap uses a non-brand orange (`#f19e1f`); Brick replaces it here.

danger.$description: The `danger` role color (Bootstrap theme color `danger`) — aliases the brand palette. Arizona Bootstrap uses Mesa (`#a95c42`); Brick is its current-palette name, with a different value.

light.$description: The `light` role color (Bootstrap theme color `light`) — aliases the brand palette. Arizona Bootstrap uses gray-300 (`#dee2e6`); Cloud replaces it here.

dark.$description: The `dark` role color (Bootstrap theme color `dark`) — aliases the brand palette. Arizona Bootstrap uses gray-800 (`#343a40`); Tinta replaces it here.
